_comment: Single source of truth for every value that ties this product to a real entity, a real host, or a real inbox. Nothing in the site hard-codes these; tools/build-site.mjs substitutes the {{TOKENS}} into a dist/ folder and REFUSES to build while any required value is still a placeholder. That is the point: you cannot ship a legal page that names nobody.

artifacts._comment: The four shipped binaries. Three download buttons exist; the Intel Mac build needs its own, which is why there are four names and only three buttons.

opencode._comment: The version Olympus was built and tested against. The app checks this at startup and warns loudly if the installed opencode is outside it.
